transcript: Khatoon, 55 saal. Aadhi bilkul hai. Suxtar 100 aad hai. Sar ghabrahat hai. Chakkar nahi. Atencine mein dard nahi hai. Novorapid 5 raat ko. Ek goli subah nahar dikhayein. Namak kam karni hai. Doft baad bilkul do baar. Chakkar hai.

medications.name: Novorapid
medications.dose: 1 tablet in the morning with breakfast
